snippet.title: Stick A Round Demo Trailer: Settle the childhood debate..
snippet.description:
Here is the new trailer for the upcoming demo of Stick A Round! Who actually found the best stick? Time to settle the debate once and for all. 🪵⚔️

We are building Stick A Round, a chaotic physics-based multiplayer sandbox where every single stick is procedurally generated. Find your branch, craft your weapon (swords, bows, slingshots), and battle it out in nostalgic mini-games.

Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3866080/Stick_A_Round/

#indiegames #gamedev #gaming #nostalgia #stickaround #steam
